title: Absolute's Talisman
summary: The Absolute’s Brand grants Advantage on death saves. The amulet grants self-only Aid once per Long Rest; removing it ends Aid.

fields.Effect: The Absolute’s Brand grants Advantage on death saves.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Aid: Action, self only, once per Long Rest. Heal 5 HP and increase maximum HP by 5 until Long Rest or until you unequip the amulet.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
